stem.text: A digital balance is used to weigh ingredients in a laboratory. When a weight is applied to the digital balance, an electronic circuit generates a current which is then converted into a digital readout on the display.
The electronic circuit gives a current of $2.0\,\text{mA}$ when a weight of $30\,\text{N}$ is applied, and a current of $0.5\,\text{mA}$ when a weight of $5\,\text{N}$ is applied.
Which calibration curve could represent this circuit?

A.alt: Option A graph: current/mA against weight/N, axes marked 0 and 2 mA and 0 and 30 N.

B.alt: Option B graph: current/mA against weight/N, axes marked 0 and 2 mA and 0 and 30 N.

C.alt: Option C graph: current/mA against weight/N, axes marked 0 and 2 mA and 0 and 30 N.

D.alt: Option D graph: current/mA against weight/N, axes marked 0 and 2 mA and 0 and 30 N.
